scope: Texas-wide moving brand; the corporate booking flow and Austin service page were reviewed.

metrics.label: Advertised booking deposit
metrics.context: Advertised website amount, not a total quote. Booking terms were not tested.

metrics.label: Listed Texas office cities
metrics.context: Company-reported: Houston, Austin, Dallas and San Antonio. Not independently audited.

observations.title: Connect low-commitment estimates to booking
observations.observed: The opening booking screen asks for origin, destination, name, email and phone before Start Booking. A separate Move Calculator is already offered on the site.
observations.improvement: Test an estimate-first option beside the inputs while retaining direct booking. Compare completion and qualified bookings; mobile usability was not tested.

observations.title: Give scale claims a clear scope and date
observations.observed: The same homepage says 37,000+ Texas families move with the company each year, while its residential section says 30,000.
observations.improvement: Reconcile the figures or label their periods and customer groups. Reuse a dated, consistently scoped proof point.

limitations: Only the opening booking step was inspected. Prices, availability, payment and successful form delivery were not tested.
The annual-volume figures may concern different periods or groups; the underlying statistics were not independently verified.
Public website review only. No forms submitted or mobile-usability, conversion, speed or internal-system tests performed.
